text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, while walking through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Could you pull for me instead?! I have to go to my part-time job now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A piece of paper is pressed tightly into my palm.
Looking closely at it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yup! The one to aim for is 2nd prize: a whole mountain of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The line is over there! I'll leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the direction Ines Fuujin pointed, a long line of families returning from shopping had formed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Using the raffle ticket Ines Fuujin handed me, I enthusiastically spun the lottery wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~~?! 
People can actually win the grand prize~?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Share some of that luck with me!
Next time I get to try, I'll be the one
winning the grand prize, just watch!
choice_data_list: Huh, this hot springs ticket is...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I'm giving that to you.
You went through the trouble of winning it, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Taking a cut out of the blue
feels a bit much, honestly.
Hurry up and stash it back in your pocket.
choice_data_list: But it was yours to begin with...
But it was yours to begin with...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's fine, just accept it graciously!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehh~?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*~... *pant*~...
Trainer, would you please
just hurry up and take it...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, got it!
Then I'll do this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This hot spring trip ticket is on hold for now! We'll go when the time is right. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew~... That settles that issue, nano.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just leave it in this room for now.
Whenever you feel like using it, it's all yours, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......What a hopeless person.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
How many—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!?
Did you come to eat ramen today, too!?
choice_data_list: No, no, I actually won 1st prize!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing, it's carrot hamburg steak!
Are you really sure I can have it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~!
I think I'll eat it after my shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Trainer. Did you really come all the way
to my part-time job just to deliver this?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow would have been fine, too.
You're actually pretty cute sometimes, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the first-prize carrot hamburg steak was handed over to Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cardboard box packed full of carrots.
I've managed to carry it to the front of the student dorms for now, but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap squeezed her eyes shut every time her stomach growled.
Could her hunger have finally reached its absolute limit...?
choice_data_list: (What would Agnes do at a time like this...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Oguri-san.
Did you get hungry?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, here, I'll share some with you.
I don't have a lot, so keep it a secret from the others, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ but cooked food tastes better
than raw ingredients anyway. Shall I
whip up something quick before handing it over?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's why you're treating me to hot pot.
I was surprised when you suddenly messaged me,
asking me to 'come to the trainer's room after work.'"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ines...!
Your Trainer's food is delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My Trainer is super capable, you know!
Well then, I guess I'll partake in the feast too~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the cardboard box full of carrots
vanished completely into their stomachs
over the course of a single night...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just one, huh~
Well, it is a raffle, so I guess that's how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“Thanks for humoring my sudden request, though!
The raffle ticket expired today, so I'm glad
it didn't go to waste!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Let me know next time you have leftover raffle tickets, Trainer.
I'll gladly draw them for you!"
choice_data_list: Could something like that really happen...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after handing Ines Fujin the carrots,
I headed home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo~, Trainer!
About the raffle tickets I gave you yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, aren't you looking kinda down?
You've had zero energy since this morning!"
choice_data_list: Actually, I drew a dud in the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No way!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no no no, that's not it!
I had no idea you were down
over something like that..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I should be apologizing to you.
Saddling you with such weird responsibility...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up making Ines Fuujin worry unnecessarily as well...
